overview.description: 7 Card Draw: each player gets seven cards, then may draw/discard (typically once) to improve. Best five-card hand wins. Less common than 5 Card Draw; often limit or pot-limit. USA.

history.origins: American draw poker variant; seven cards instead of five, one (or two) draw round(s). Less common than 5 Card Draw; popular in home and dealer's choice games.
timeline: Early 20th century: Draw poker variants (5 and 7 card)
Present: 7 Card Draw in mixed and home games

nullReasons.evolution: No documented evolutionary changes; game emerged as a stable tradition.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from your seven cards after the draw.
rules.gameplay: Each player receives seven cards. Betting round; then each player discards and draws (typically once) to replace discarded cards. Final betting; showdown; best five-card hand wins.
keyRules: Seven cards each; one (or two) draw round(s)

strategy.basic: Draw for straights and flushes; bet with pairs and two-pair.
strategy.intermediate: Position and draw size; read opponents' draw patterns.
strategy.advanced: Bluff draws; value-bet made hands; 7 cards = more redraws.
tips: Seven cards, one draw round; best five cards.

phases.label: Deal
phases.notes: Dealer deals seven cards to each player.

phases.label: Betting (before draw)
phases.notes: First betting round; begins left of big blind (or left of dealer if ante-only).

phases.label: Draw
phases.notes: Each player may discard zero to four cards and receive that many replacements from the stock.

phases.label: Betting (after draw)
phases.notes: Second betting round; minimum raise often twice the final bet of the first round.

phases.label: Showdown
phases.notes: Each player selects best five cards from seven; highest hand wins the pot.

ante.description: Post an agreed ante before the deal. Optional; some play with blinds only, some with ante in addition to blinds.
ante.constraints: Legal in ante phase when game uses ante; all players must ante.

deal.description: Dealer deals seven cards to each player, one at a time, clockwise.
deal.constraints: Performed by the dealer at start of hand.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Forfeit the hand and drop out of the current pot.
fold.constraints: Legal during any betting round when it is your turn to act.

check.description: Decline to bet when no bet has been made in the current round.
check.constraints: Legal only when no one has bet in the current betting round.

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made and you have not yet acted to the current bet.

bet.description: Place a bet; minimum is the agreed minimum (e.g. big blind or limit small bet).
bet.constraints: Legal during a betting round when no bet has been made, or when raising is allowed.

raise.description: Increase the current bet; in limit games the raise amount is fixed; after the draw, minimum is often twice the first round's final bet.
raise.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made and raises are allowed; subject to limit and cap.

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Reveal best five cards from your seven at showdown; highest hand wins the pot.
reveal_hand.constraints: Legal in showdown phase; each player selects five cards to count.

award_pot.reason: This game has no pot to award.

play_card.reason: 7 Card Draw is not a trick-taking game; cards are discarded and replaced, not played to a trick.

draw.description: Receive replacement cards from the stock for each card discarded; one draw round per player, zero to four cards.
draw.constraints: Legal during the draw phase; draw count must equal number of cards just discarded.

discard.description: Discard from zero to four cards face down; discarded cards are replaced by the same number from the stock.
discard.constraints: Legal during the draw phase; must discard before drawing replacements; 0-4 cards.

pass.reason: This game has no pass action.

bid.reason: This game has no bid action.

meld.reason: This game has no meld action.

go_out.reason: This game has no go-out action.

drawSources.notes: Replacements for discarded cards; 0-4 per player in one draw round.

engine.deckDescription: A standard 52-card French deck comprising four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit contains thirteen ranks: Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King, providing versatile options for various card games.
engine.suitDescription: Suits and ranks are as defined in the deck description above; no separate suit or rank set is used for this game.
